DISK_STATUS.reading: the storage guard the campaign already uses, not a second threshold set

HEALTH.reading: read at generation time, straight after the live tests, which deliberately provoke a lease collision and a refusal: a WARNING here can be their signature rather than an operational fault. The health artefact, rewritten by every tick, is the authority.

LEASE_READING: a tick that neither renews nor releases its lease is abandoned after this many seconds; the shared lease cannot always prove a pid is dead on this platform, so the age rule is short enough that a killed tick can never cost a window
NEXT_GATE: the declared period closes at 2026-10-22T16:21:20Z; then the consolidation and the independent verification run automatically and the gate becomes the ECO-1 decision

SCHEDULER_STATE.reading: the task's own registration, read from the scheduler; it is never treated as evidence that a measurement was taken

collection_is_evidence: a scheduled tick that took no sample is not a measurement: the evidence is the window with its raw bytes and its hash, and the run log only says what the tick did

closure_artifact.written_by: this command, once the declared period has ended
